shield.label: Cloudflare protection for the shop
shield.help: The shop's own rules at Cloudflare: the security level, the browser check, SSL Full (strict), refusing the addresses robots try, and — off by default — a challenge on the admin sign-in page and a limit on admin sign-in tries (owner only). Every rule is limited to the shop's host names. Nothing is sent until someone presses "Send to Cloudflare".
